changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO dim.dim_instrument (instrument_id, symbol, name, asset_class_id, exchange_id, currency_id, sector_id, lot_size, isin, valid_from, is_current, _source, _ingest_ts) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(instrument_id),0) FROM dim.dim_instrument) + row_number() OVER (ORDER BY symbol) AS instrument_id, symbol, company_name, 1, 4, 2, -1, CAST(market_lot AS INTEGER), isin, listing_date, true, 'nse-equity-master', now() FROM read_parquet('datalake/data/silver/master/equity/equity_master.parquet') WHERE symbol NOT IN (SELECT symbol FROM dim.dim_instrument)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO dim.dim_equity (instrument_id) SELECT instrument_id FROM dim.dim_instrument WHERE asset_class_id=1 AND instrument_id NOT IN (SELECT instrument_id FROM dim.dim_equity)

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM dim.dim_equity WHERE instrument_id IN (SELECT instrument_id FROM dim.dim_instrument WHERE _source='nse-equity-master')

changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO dim.dim_instrument (instrument_id, symbol, name, asset_class_id, exchange_id, currency_id, sector_id, is_current, _source, _ingest_ts) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(instrument_id),0) FROM dim.dim_instrument) + row_number() OVER (ORDER BY symbol) AS instrument_id, symbol, symbol, CASE WHEN symbol LIKE '^%' THEN 2 WHEN symbol LIKE '%-USD' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN symbol LIKE '^%' THEN 1 WHEN symbol LIKE '%-USD' THEN 9 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN symbol LIKE '%-USD' THEN 7 ELSE 1 END, -1, true, 'yahoo', now() FROM (SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM read_csv('datalake/data/silver/yahoo/yahoo_ohlcv.csv', header=true)) WHERE symbol NOT IN (SELECT symbol FROM dim.dim_instrument)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO dim.dim_equity (instrument_id) SELECT instrument_id FROM dim.dim_instrument WHERE asset_class_id IN (1,2) AND instrument_id NOT IN (SELECT instrument_id FROM dim.dim_equity)

INSERT INTO dim.fact_market_ohlcv SELECT d.instrument_id, CAST(y.date AS DATE), y.epoch, y.open, y.high, y.low, y.close, y.adj_close, y.volume, now(), year(CAST(y.date AS DATE)) FROM (SELECT * EXCLUDE rn FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol, date ORDER BY epoch DESC) AS rn FROM read_csv('datalake/data/silver/yahoo/yahoo_ohlcv.csv', header=true)) WHERE rn=1) y JOIN dim.dim_instrument d ON d.symbol = y.symbol

INSERT INTO dim.fact_crypto_ohlcv SELECT d.instrument_id, to_timestamp(CAST(json_extract_string(k.data, 0) AS BIGINT)/1000)::DATE AS date, CAST(json_extract_string(k.data, 0) AS BIGINT)/1000 AS epoch, CAST(json_extract_string(k.data, 1) AS DOUBLE) AS open, CAST(json_extract_string(k.data, 2) AS DOUBLE) AS high, CAST(json_extract_string(k.data, 3) AS DOUBLE) AS low, CAST(json_extract_string(k.data, 4) AS DOUBLE) AS close, CAST(json_extract_string(k.data, 5) AS DOUBLE) AS volume, CAST(json_extract_string(k.data, 7) AS DOUBLE) AS quote_volume, CAST(json_extract_string(k.data, 8) AS BIGINT) AS trades, now(), year(to_timestamp(CAST(json_extract_string(k.data, 0) AS BIGINT)/1000)::DATE) FROM (SELECT replace(replace(filename, 'datalake/data/bronze/binance/key=', ''), '/data.raw', '') AS pair, unnest(from_json(replace(cast(content as VARCHAR), chr(92)||'x22', '\"'), '["JSON[]"]')) AS data FROM read_blob('datalake/data/bronze/binance/key=*/data.raw')) k JOIN dim.dim_instrument d ON d.symbol = k.pair

INSERT INTO dim.fact_macro_obs (indicator_id, country_iso3, date, year, value, period_type, source_id, lastupdated) SELECT indicator_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(country_iso3,''), 'UNK'), COALESCE(TRY_CAST(date AS DATE), make_date(COALESCE(year, 2000), 1, 1)), year, value, period_type, source_id, TRY_CAST(lastupdated AS TIMESTAMPTZ) FROM (SELECT * EXCLUDE rn FROM (SELECT *, COALESCE(NULLIF(country_iso3,''), 'UNK') AS country_iso3_fixed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY indicator_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(country_iso3,''), 'UNK'), date ORDER BY lastupdated DESC) AS rn FROM read_parquet('datalake/data/silver/macro/observations.parquet')) WHERE rn=1) WHERE TRY_CAST(date AS DATE) IS NOT NULL OR year IS NOT NULL

INSERT INTO dim.fact_rates_daily (indicator_id, date, value, source_id, _ingest_ts, year) SELECT indicator_id, date, value, 'treasury', now(), year(date) FROM ( SELECT t.date, unnest(GENERATE_SERIES(1,13)) AS col_idx, unnest([t."1 Mo", t."2 Mo", t."3 Mo", t."4 Mo", t."6 Mo", t."1 Yr", t."2 Yr", t."3 Yr", t."5 Yr", t."7 Yr", t."10 Yr", t."20 Yr", t."30 Yr"]) AS value, unnest(['TREASURY_1MO','TREASURY_2MO','TREASURY_3MO','TREASURY_4MO','TREASURY_6MO','TREASURY_1YR','TREASURY_2YR','TREASURY_3YR','TREASURY_5YR','TREASURY_7YR','TREASURY_10YR','TREASURY_20YR','TREASURY_30YR']) AS indicator_id FROM read_csv('datalake/data/bronze/treasury/key=treasury/data.raw', header=true) AS t ) WHERE value IS NOT NULL

changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO dim.fact_rates_daily (indicator_id, date, value, source_id, _ingest_ts, year) SELECT indicator_id, date, value, 'fred', now(), year(date) FROM ( SELECT f.date, unnest(['SHILLER_SP500','SHILLER_DIVIDEND','SHILLER_EARNINGS','SHILLER_CPI','SHILLER_LONG_RATE','SHILLER_PE10']) AS indicator_id, unnest([f."SP500", f."Dividend", f."Earnings", f."Consumer Price Index", f."Long Interest Rate", f."PE10"]) AS value FROM read_csv('datalake/data/bronze/fred/key=DGS10/data.raw', header=true) AS f ) WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND value != 0

changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM dim.fact_filings

INSERT INTO dim.fact_filings (instrument_id, accession_number, filing_date, form_type, period_of_report, entity_name, cik, url, _ingest_ts) SELECT d.instrument_id, replace(cast(sub.acc as VARCHAR), '"', ''), TRY_CAST(replace(cast(sub.fd as VARCHAR), '"', '') AS DATE), replace(cast(sub.frm as VARCHAR), '"', ''), NULL, sec_raw.entity_name, sec_raw.cik, 'https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/' || sec_raw.cik || '/' || replace(replace(cast(sub.acc as VARCHAR), '"', ''), '-', '') || '/' || replace(cast(sub.pd as VARCHAR), '"', ''), now() FROM (SELECT replace(replace(filename, 'datalake/data/bronze/sec/key=', ''), '/data.raw', '') as ticker, json_extract_string(replace(cast(content as VARCHAR), chr(92)||'x22', '"'), '$.name') as entity_name, json_extract_string(replace(cast(content as VARCHAR), chr(92)||'x22', '"'), '$.cik') as cik, replace(cast(content as VARCHAR), chr(92)||'x22', '"') AS fc FROM read_blob('datalake/data/bronze/sec/key=*/data.raw')) sec_raw, LATERAL ( SELECT unnest(from_json(json_extract_string(sec_raw.fc, '$.filings.recent.accessionNumber'), '["JSON"]')) AS acc, unnest(from_json(json_extract_string(sec_raw.fc, '$.filings.recent.filingDate'), '["JSON"]')) AS fd, unnest(from_json(json_extract_string(sec_raw.fc, '$.filings.recent.form'), '["JSON"]')) AS frm, unnest(from_json(json_extract_string(sec_raw.fc, '$.filings.recent.primaryDocument'), '["JSON"]')) AS pd ) sub JOIN dim.dim_instrument d ON d.symbol = sec_raw.ticker

changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW hedge_gold.vw_returns_daily AS SELECT i.symbol, i.asset_class_id, f.date, f.close, f.volume, (f.close / lag(f.close) OVER (PARTITION BY f.instrument_id ORDER BY f.date) - 1) AS ret_1d FROM dim.fact_market_ohlcv f JOIN dim.dim_instrument i USING(instrument_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW hedge_gold.vw_returns_cumulative AS SELECT symbol, date, close, ret_1d, exp(sum(ln(1 + ret_1d)) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date)) AS cum_return FROM hedge_gold.vw_returns_daily WHERE ret_1d IS NOT NULL

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW hedge_gold.vw_volatility_30d AS SELECT symbol, date, ret_1d, stddev(ret_1d) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date ROWS 30 PRECEDING) * sqrt(252) AS vol_30d_annualized FROM hedge_gold.vw_returns_daily WHERE ret_1d IS NOT NULL

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW hedge_gold.vw_macro_yoy AS SELECT m.indicator_id, m.country_iso3, m.date, m.value, m.source_id, lag(m.value) OVER (PARTITION BY m.indicator_id, m.country_iso3 ORDER BY m.date) AS prev_value, (m.value / nullif(lag(m.value) OVER (PARTITION BY m.indicator_id, m.country_iso3 ORDER BY m.date), 0) - 1) AS yoy_pct FROM dim.fact_macro_obs m

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW hedge_gold.vw_instrument_detail AS SELECT i.instrument_id, i.symbol, i.name, i.isin, ac.asset_class_code, ac.asset_class_name, c.currency_code, c.currency_name, s.sector_name, ind.industry_name, e.exchange_code, e.exchange_name, e.country_iso3, i.lot_size, i.valid_from, i.valid_to, i.is_current FROM dim.dim_instrument i JOIN dim.dim_asset_class ac ON ac.asset_class_id = i.asset_class_id JOIN dim.dim_currency c ON c.currency_id = i.currency_id JOIN dim.dim_sector s ON s.sector_id = i.sector_id JOIN dim.dim_industry ind ON ind.industry_id = s.industry_id JOIN dim.dim_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = i.exchange_id

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW hedge_gold.vw_source_coverage AS SELECT 'dim_instrument' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT _source) AS sources FROM dim.dim_instrument WHERE instrument_id > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_market_ohlcv', count(*), count(DISTINCT i._source) FROM dim.fact_market_ohlcv f JOIN dim.dim_instrument i USING(instrument_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_macro_obs', count(*), count(DISTINCT source_id) FROM dim.fact_macro_obs UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_crypto_ohlcv', count(*), 0 FROM dim.fact_crypto_ohlcv UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_rates_daily', count(*), count(DISTINCT source_id) FROM dim.fact_rates_daily UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_filings', count(*), 0 FROM dim.fact_filings

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW market.crypto AS SELECT i.symbol, f.date, f.open, f.high, f.low, f.close, f.volume, f.trades, f.year FROM dim.fact_crypto_ohlcv f JOIN dim.dim_instrument i USING(instrument_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW macro.observation AS SELECT m.indicator_id, i.indicator_name, m.country_iso3, c.country_name, m.date, m.value, m.period_type, m.source_id FROM dim.fact_macro_obs m JOIN dim.dim_indicator i USING(indicator_id) JOIN dim.dim_country c USING(country_iso3)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW market.filings AS SELECT i.symbol, f.accession_number, f.filing_date, f.form_type, f.entity_name, f.url FROM dim.fact_filings f JOIN dim.dim_instrument i USING(instrument_id)
